map.达西–魏斯巴赫按摩擦系数通用，适合清水与多数牛顿流体；海曾–威廉多用于给水管道经: Darcy-Weisbach works generically from the friction factor and suits clean water and most Newtonian fluids; Hazen-Williams is mostly used for empirical estimates in water supply pipes. The choice depends on the fluid and engineering convention.

map.雷诺数判断层流/湍流：<2000 层流、>4000 湍流，摩擦系数取法不同。结果: The Reynolds number distinguishes laminar from turbulent flow: <2000 laminar, >4000 turbulent, and the friction factor is taken differently. The result changes with the flow state, and it is the prior judgement in any pressure drop calculation.
map.雷诺数有什么用？: What is the Reynolds number used for?
